thread.title: Stock Market Today Morning Update: Indexes Open Higher As Apple Rebounds

author: EdJenner
title: Stock Market Today Morning Update: Indexes Open Higher As Apple Rebounds
text:
Weakness in Apple ( AAPL ) stock weighed on the stock market late last week, hurt in part by cautious comments from Morgan Stanley. 
X 
But it was a different story early Monday as Apple stock rebounded and major stock indexes opened slightly higher. 
The Dow Jones industrial average, S&P 500 and Nasdaq composite showed gains of around 0.2% to 0.3% just after the opening bell. 
The 10-year Treasury yield edged up 1 basis point to around 2.97%. Apple Stock Down 5% For Week 
Apple had a bad week ahead of its May 1 earnings report. Shares were also weighed down by a weak sales outlook from Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing ( TSM ). It’s a big Apple supplier. The company cited weak smartphone demand. Lululemon Downgraded 
Shares of Lululemon Athletica ( LULU ) fell 1% in early trade, hurt by a Needham downgrade to hold from buy. The athletic apparel retailer has been a top Leaderboard performer 
In the stock market today , Halliburton ( HAL ) traded lower early Monday on mixed Q1 results . Toymaker Hasbro ( HAS ) also got off to a rough start, down 4%, on a sales miss.
